name: Bara Boarders
source: Bara Boarders is a short and cute VN that takes place on an idyllic beach in Hawaii. You are a newbie surfer, whose been out on the waves enough times, but is aching to finally catch a wave and stay up on your board for the first time. You’re determined that today will be the day! Thing is, you’re going to run into distractions, other handsome surfers - will they hinder or can they help you on your quest in paradise today?
translation:
《猛男冲浪者》是一款发生在夏威夷田园海滩上的短篇可爱视觉小说。你是一名新手冲浪者，已经在海浪上练习过几次，却渴望终于成功乘浪，并第一次站稳冲浪板。你下定决心，今天一定要做到！

问题在于，你会遇到各种干扰，还有其他英俊的冲浪者——他们会妨碍你，还是能帮助你在今日的天堂完成目标？
